name: Wargos Pumpkin Patch
description: Wargos Pumpkin Patch is an independent pumpkin patch in Luthersville, GA. It grows Strawberries, Pumpkins, and Flowers, with picking through spring and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
